title: Docs: auth.email.secure_password_change described as "require current password", but it maps to reauthentication; no config.toml key for the real setting
body: The CLI config reference describes auth.email.secure_password_change as requiring the current password when changing it. In the CLI code the key maps to the reauthentication setting instead. There is no config.toml key for the require-current-password setting (GOTRUE_SECURITY_UPDATE_PASSWORD_REQUIRE_CURRENT_PASSWORD). Please fix the docs and add a key.

title: Escalation of SU-513972 — staging deployment blocked by cron.job lock privileges (PostgreSQL 17.6)
